title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Grok 4.6 Launch & CursorBench #1: xAI launched Grok 4.6, capturing the top rank on CursorBench for real-world coding performance while offering expanded free usage limits.
OpenAI Previews GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast: OpenAI announced Ultrafast mode for GPT-5.6 Sol delivering up to 14x speed improvements in the API, alongside desktop Computer History memory.
Qwen3.8 Open Weights & Local 27B: Alibaba released open weights for Qwen3.8-27B and Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B, enabling local execution on 17GB RAM via Unsloth Dynamic GGUFs.
WSJ Report on Anthropic Executive: WSJ reported on historical investment solicitations involving Anthropic leadership family members and external venture contacts.
AlphaSense Debuts SuperAnalyst Agent: AlphaSense launched SuperAnalyst, an autonomous AI research agent designed for multi-step market intelligence and financial analysis.

items.title: @elonmusk: Grok 4.6 Ranks #1 on CursorBench
items.body: Elon Musk highlighted Grok 4.6 taking the #1 spot on CursorBench 3.2 for real-world coding benchmarks, outperforming Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol with high efficiency. xAI also reset usage limits to support developers building on the new model.

items.title: @thsottiaux: OpenAI Previews GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast
items.body: OpenAI previewed an Ultrafast mode for GPT-5.6 Sol running at up to 14x speed. The feature is debuting in the OpenAI API for select enterprise partners before broader rollout.

items.title: @UnslothAI: Qwen3.8-27B Open Weights & Local Execution
items.body: Alibaba released open weights for Qwen3.8-27B and Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B. Unsloth AI announced support for running Qwen3.8-27B locally on 17GB RAM using Dynamic GGUF quantizations.

items.title: @0xCodila: Karpathy's Stanford Lecture on Graph Engineering
items.body: Former OpenAI scientist Andrej Karpathy delivered a Stanford lecture detailing AI engineering architecture, focusing on prompt programming, goal-oriented agent loops, and directed graph message passing.

items.title: @packyM: ChatGPT Computer History Memory Feature
items.body: OpenAI introduced Computer History in the desktop app, allowing ChatGPT to retain activity context across local desktop applications for personalized interaction.

items.title: @iuditg: Major Tech Company SSL Certificate Expiration
items.body: Engineers noted an operational oversight where a $2 trillion tech firm temporarily allowed a primary SSL certificate to expire, causing public service warnings.

items.title: @unusual_whales: WSJ Report on Anthropic Leadership
items.body: The Wall Street Journal published an investigative piece examining past business ventures and pitch documents linked to family members of Anthropic leadership.

items.title: @AlphaSenseInc: SuperAnalyst Financial AI Agent Launch
items.body: AlphaSense launched SuperAnalyst, an autonomous research agent built to perform multi-step equity research, earnings analysis, and real-time market monitoring for financial institutions.

items.title: @unusual_whales: Unusual Whales API Free Trial
items.body: Unusual Whales announced a public API trial providing real-time data access for equity options flow, stock transactions, and prediction markets.

items.title: @HypernativeLabs: Real-Time Threat Interception in Web3
items.body: Hypernative Labs emphasized the shift toward preventative security in decentralized finance, demonstrating real-time threat interception before transactions execute.

items.title: @TomKlingenstein: Reflections on American Founding Principles
items.body: Tom Klingenstein published an essay on the enduring moral foundation of the Declaration of Independence and its role in guiding national purpose.

items.title: @FCBayernEN: Anniversary of Historic 8-2 Victory
items.body: FC Bayern Munich commemorated the anniversary of their iconic 8-2 Champions League quarterfinal victory over Barcelona in Lisbon.

items.title: @Variety: Sadie Sink on Spider-Man Set Experience
items.body: Actress Sadie Sink shared insights into working on the set of Spider-Man: Brand New Day, highlighting the collaborative atmosphere during filming.

items.title: @cuichenghao: Inspirational Story of Self-Taught Creator
items.body: A viral story highlighted a Yunnan woman who taught herself video editing and dance to build an online audience, successfully supporting her family after her husband's illness.
